Definition: properly, a hewing; concretely, a quarry
BiblicalUsage: Machtseb is the quarry, the hewing, and both of its appearances are about buying hewn stone to repair the house of the LORD, in 2 Kings 12:12 and again in 2 Kings 22:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that God counts the quarry work as holy work: the stone had to be hewn before the temple could stand.
